lines.t:
Numerical values that measure the strength and
effects of <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> and <c:ffff00>objects<c> for comparison.
There are 9 types; they vary by the {{part}}'s <c:ffff00>{{slot}}<c> or the
{{object}}'s {{effect}}:
  <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> (head, arms, legs)
  <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c> (head, arms)
  <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> (head, arms)
  <c:ffff00>{{uses}}<c> (head)
  <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> (legs)
